skill.name: daily-routine-note-creation
skill.description: Create daily routine notes with unchecked tasks from yesterday.

skill:
create routine,prepare routine,routine note,todos,todo,unchecked,carry forward,carry-over,daily routine
task today,yesterday,daily,routine,move,carry,forward,unchecked
plan today,tomorrow,yesterday
- Routine notes live at `routine/[Month]/[Month] [Day] - [Weekday].md`.
- From yesterday's note, extract only unchecked task lines matching `- [ ] ...`. - Ignore checked tasks (`- [x]`), headings, events, notes, and placeholder text. - If yesterday's note is missing or has no unchecked tasks, proceed with an empty carry-forward list.
## Summary
- [ ] [Task 1] - [ ] [Task 2] ...
### First: `read_file` yesterday's note
### Then: read or create today's note using unchecked tasks from the read result in history If today's note does not exist, create it with the note template. If today's note already exists, read it and append the carried-forward tasks instead of using create_new. Keep the source note unchanged and do not duplicate a task already present in today's note.
